lines.zh: 我一步踩裂三块碎石，肩膀撞开树枝。
lines.en: Each step cracks three stones; my shoulder shoves the branches aside.

lines.zh: 沉重的脚步，可转向比你想的快。
lines.en: Heavy steps, yet I turn faster than you expect.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，栅栏在我胸口裂开。
lines.en: I do not go around; the fence splits on my chest.

lines.zh: 走路时地面在抖，我在听。
lines.en: The ground shakes as I walk, and I am listening.

lines.zh: 我把泥土踩成硬坑，一路向前。
lines.en: I press the soil into hard pits, moving straight on.

lines.zh: 别数我的步子，数你的退路。
lines.en: Do not count my steps; count your ways out.

lines.zh: 腐肉在袋里晃，香气引我走。
lines.en: Rotten flesh swings in my sack and pulls me forward.

lines.zh: 我踩碎蘑菇，孢子沾满小腿。
lines.en: I crush the mushrooms, spores clinging to my shins.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖响，但从不弯下去。
lines.en: My knees creak, but they never bend for you.

lines.zh: 野地里我走成一条直线，很省力。
lines.en: Across the wild I walk a straight line, wasting nothing.

lines.zh: 别站树下，我过来时树会断。
lines.en: Do not stand under trees; when I pass, they break.

lines.zh: 我拖着影子走，影子比我先到。
lines.en: I drag my shadow along; it arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 我站着，肌肉还在慢慢鼓动。
lines.en: I stand still, and my muscles keep swelling slowly.

lines.zh: 呼吸很粗，像风钻过破桶。
lines.en: My breath is coarse, wind through a cracked barrel.

lines.zh: 我把指节捏响，一节一节。
lines.en: I crack my knuckles, one joint at a time.

lines.zh: 阳光照我，皮肤只是发白。
lines.en: Sunlight only bleaches my skin a little.

lines.zh: 我不动，是在攒下一次挥拳。
lines.en: Standing still, I am saving up one swing.

lines.zh: 远处有羊叫，我懒得过去。
lines.en: Sheep bleat far off; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我靠着石墙，墙往里陷了一寸。
lines.en: I lean on the stone wall; it sinks an inch.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道让我安心。
lines.en: The smell of rotten flesh settles me.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，等骨头不疼。
lines.en: I wait for night, when my bones stop aching.

lines.zh: 虫子爬过我手臂，我不赶它。
lines.en: Bugs crawl my arm; I let them stay.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子骨节卡了一下。
lines.en: I raise my head; a vertebra catches, then pops.

lines.zh: 先看你的腿，那里最容易断。
lines.en: First I look at your legs; they break easiest.

lines.zh: 你站得挺直，我记住了。
lines.en: You stand up straight. I have noted that.

lines.zh: 我偏头，想弄清你为何不跑。
lines.en: I tilt my head, puzzled that you do not run.

lines.zh: 你的盾太小，挡不住我的肩。
lines.en: Your shield is too small to stop my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我看你的手，看它抖不抖。
lines.en: I watch your hands, whether they tremble.

lines.zh: 眼窝里没有眼，可我看得清。
lines.en: No eyes in my sockets, yet I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你袖口有铁腥，我闻着很清楚。
lines.en: Iron and old sweat on your cuff; I smell it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你背后的路，那条最窄。
lines.en: I stare at the path behind you, the narrow one.

lines.zh: 我看你很久，久到你以为我瞎。
lines.en: I look so long you think me blind.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，我的皮厚。
lines.en: That was light; my hide is thick.

lines.zh: 疼，但疼不会让我停下。
lines.en: It hurts, but hurting does not stop me.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，又站正了。
lines.en: I sway once, then straighten up again.

lines.zh: 你砍进肉里，卡在骨头上。
lines.en: Your blade bites meat and sticks on bone.

lines.zh: 我的血又黑又稠，流得慢。
lines.en: My blood is black and thick, and runs slow.

lines.zh: 我也想喊，可声音只会更低。
lines.en: I want to shout, but my voice only deepens.

lines.zh: 伤口合得很慢，但会合上。
lines.en: The wound closes slowly, but it closes.

lines.zh: 你打得不错，再用力一点。
lines.en: Good hit. Now swing harder.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，只是捡回呼吸。
lines.en: I bend over only to gather my breath.

lines.zh: 再来，我还没觉得够。
lines.en: Again; I have not had enough.

lines.zh: 面包我不要，我要你那把剑。
lines.en: Keep the bread; I want that sword of yours.

lines.zh: 你把食物举高，我只想掰断它。
lines.en: You raise the food high; I only want to snap it.

lines.zh: 别晃那根胡萝卜，我不吃草。
lines.en: Stop waving that carrot; I do not eat grass.

lines.zh: 肉香有点用，但不如你的骨头。
lines.en: Meat smells fine, but your bones smell better.

lines.zh: 我凑近嗅了嗅，然后摇头走开。
lines.en: I lean in, sniff, then shake my head and leave.

lines.zh: 腐肉够我吃，你的手不必伸来。
lines.en: Rotten flesh feeds me; keep your hand back.

lines.zh: 你把骨头扔远，我一步都没动。
lines.en: You throw a bone far off; I do not move.

lines.zh: 金苹果？我牙缝里塞过更硬的。
lines.en: A golden apple? My teeth have chewed harder things.

lines.zh: 你举着小麦，我闻到了笑话。
lines.en: You hold up wheat, and I smell a joke.

lines.zh: 诱惑我的是你退后的那半步。
lines.en: What tempts me is that half step you take back.

lines.zh: 撞上了，你的脚在地上滑出两道痕。
lines.en: We collide; your feet leave two long marks.

lines.zh: 我肩一顶，你就退了三步。
lines.en: One shove of my shoulder, and you are three steps back.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我的皮很硬。
lines.en: Do not stand so close; my hide is hard.

lines.zh: 撞开你比推开一扇门省力。
lines.en: Bumping you aside is easier than opening a door.

lines.zh: 我的重量压过来，你听见闷响。
lines.en: My weight leans in; you hear a dull thud.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我晃都没晃。
lines.en: You hit me, and I do not even sway.

lines.zh: 让路，或者被我抬过去。
lines.en: Step aside, or be carried past.

lines.zh: 身体碰身体，你退了，我没退。
lines.en: Body to body: you give ground, I do not.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡你，像挡一阵风。
lines.en: I raise an arm to stop you, like stopping wind.

lines.zh: 这一下不算打，只是提醒。
lines.en: That was no blow, only a reminder.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，谁也不必说话。
lines.en: We stand shoulder to shoulder; nothing needs saying.

lines.zh: 她比我矮半个头，力气只差一点。
lines.en: She is half a head shorter, nearly as strong.

lines.zh: 我们互相磨牙，算作问候。
lines.en: We grind our teeth at each other as greeting.

lines.zh: 两副厚皮靠在一起，很暖。
lines.en: Two thick hides lean together, and it is warm.

lines.zh: 她推我一下，我退了半步，笑了。
lines.en: She shoves me; I give half a step and grin.

lines.zh: 我们在同一个坑里睡，很挤。
lines.en: We sleep in one pit, and it is crowded.

lines.zh: 她的伤在背上，我替她挡着。
lines.en: Her wound is on her back; I stand behind her.

lines.zh: 我们不必成双，也不怕落单。
lines.en: We need no pairing, and we fear no solitude.

lines.zh: 腐肉分她一半，她嫌我小气。
lines.en: I split the rotten flesh; she calls me stingy.

lines.zh: 两双沉脚步，把夜里踩出节奏。
lines.en: Two heavy gaits beat a rhythm through the night.

lines.zh: 地上有根骨头，我弯腰捡起来。
lines.en: A bone lies on the ground; I bend and take it.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，就把东西塞进腰带。
lines.en: No pockets on me, so it goes into my belt.

lines.zh: 这顶破帽子，戴上也不合头。
lines.en: This torn hat does not fit my head either.

lines.zh: 我捡起石块，掂了掂，又丢下。
lines.en: I pick up a stone, weigh it, and drop it.

lines.zh: 掉下来的肉，我不会让它留着。
lines.en: Meat that falls will not lie there long.

lines.zh: 我手上只有三根指头能合拢。
lines.en: Only three of my fingers still close properly.

lines.zh: 铁片我收着，用来磨指甲。
lines.en: I keep the iron scrap to file my nails.

lines.zh: 你丢的东西，弯下腰就是我的。
lines.en: What you drop becomes mine when I bend low.

lines.zh: 我抓着木棍，握得比你想的稳。
lines.en: I grip the stick, steadier than you would guess.

lines.zh: 小东西我不捡，太费腰。
lines.en: Small things I leave; bending costs too much.

lines.zh: 你进入十步，我的喉咙先响了。
lines.en: You come within ten paces, and my throat sounds first.

lines.zh: 气味对上了，我认得这种恐惧。
lines.en: The scent matches; I know this kind of fear.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你却在退。
lines.en: I do not move, and yet you step back.

lines.zh: 就是你，站得最直的那个。
lines.en: You, the one standing straightest of all.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你还在原地。
lines.en: I count to three, and you have not moved.

lines.zh: 眼睛没有用，我靠震动的地面找你。
lines.en: Eyes are useless; I find you by the trembling ground.

lines.zh: 你砍我一刀，我就认准你了。
lines.en: You cut me once, and I have chosen you.

lines.zh: 拐角后面，你的呼吸太重。
lines.en: Behind the corner, your breathing is too loud.

lines.zh: 我不挑目标，但今天挑你。
lines.en: I am not choosy, but today I choose you.

lines.zh: 你的同伴跑了，你还站着。
lines.en: Your companions ran; you are still standing.

lines.zh: 锁定了，脚下的土开始松。
lines.en: Locked on; the soil under me begins to give.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，肩头对着你。
lines.en: I turn my body sideways, shoulder aimed at you.

lines.zh: 你离得够近了，我的手指在收。
lines.en: Close enough now; my fingers are curling in.

lines.zh: 还没动手，你已经屏住气。
lines.en: Before I move, you already hold your breath.

lines.zh: 你把水壶掉在地上，那声音报了名。
lines.en: You drop your waterskin, and the sound gives you away.

lines.zh: 你跑，我不追，我直接截过去。
lines.en: Run if you like; I do not chase, I cut you off.

lines.zh: 我的脚步沉，可每一步都很长。
lines.en: My steps fall heavy, but each one is long.

lines.zh: 你绕树三圈，我拆了三棵树。
lines.en: You circle three trees; I have broken all three.

lines.zh: 门关上了，我从门框进去。
lines.en: The door shuts; I come through the frame.

lines.zh: 你在栏上跳，我一下一下地撞。
lines.en: You hop on the fence; I pound it, blow by blow.

lines.zh: 我闷着声追，气留着挥拳。
lines.en: I chase in silence, saving my breath for the swing.

lines.zh: 你每回头一次，我就近两步。
lines.en: Every time you glance back, I gain two paces.

lines.zh: 我踩过你的脚印，把它们压平。
lines.en: I step on your prints and flatten them.

lines.zh: 你藏进草里，草太矮了。
lines.en: You hide in the grass; the grass is too short.

lines.zh: 我推倒你的梯子，慢慢来。
lines.en: I push down your ladder, taking my time.

lines.zh: 你下水，我坐在岸上砸石头。
lines.en: Go in the water; I sit on the bank throwing stones.

lines.zh: 一路的东西都碎了，不是我小心。
lines.en: Everything along the way breaks; I am not careful.

lines.zh: 你喘得厉害，我还没开始。
lines.en: You are already gasping; I have not started.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，像走进一条窄巷。
lines.en: I follow you like walking down a narrow alley.

lines.zh: 我推倒一辆车，堵住你的退路。
lines.en: I tip a cart over to block your way back.

lines.zh: 你转到石头后面，我搬开石头。
lines.en: You duck behind a rock; I move the rock.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，就离你的声音近一点。
lines.en: Every step brings me closer to the sound of you.

lines.zh: 你停下来喘，我也停下来。
lines.en: You stop to breathe, and so do I.

lines.zh: 这一拳打在你盾上，盾还在响。
lines.en: My fist lands on your shield; the shield still rings.

lines.zh: 我抬手，你飞出去，撞在树上。
lines.en: I raise my arm; you fly and hit a tree.

lines.zh: 你被震得站不稳，眼睛在转。
lines.en: The shock steals your footing; your eyes spin.

lines.zh: 骨头断的声音，我听着很熟。
lines.en: The sound of bones giving is familiar to me.

lines.zh: 我不连打，一拳就够你想半天。
lines.en: I do not combo; one punch keeps you thinking.

lines.zh: 你退得太急，脚跟磕在石上。
lines.en: You retreat too fast and crack your heel on stone.

lines.zh: 我把你按进泥里，泥很软。
lines.en: I press you into the mud, and the mud is soft.

lines.zh: 拳头下去，泥里多出个坑。
lines.en: The fist comes down and leaves a pit in the mud.

lines.zh: 你的剑划开我的皮，我照样挥。
lines.en: Your sword opens my hide; I swing anyway.

lines.zh: 这一下没打中，但地面裂了。
lines.en: That one missed, but the ground cracked.

lines.zh: 我抓你肩膀，指头陷进去了。
lines.en: I grab your shoulder, and my fingers sink in.

lines.zh: 第一下你挡住了，第三下没有。
lines.en: You stopped the first; the third went through.

lines.zh: 打你就是把你推回黑暗里。
lines.en: Hitting you is pushing you back into the dark.

lines.zh: 我收手了，你还在原地转。
lines.en: I have stopped swinging; you are still spinning.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的盾，连人一起推开。
lines.en: I grab your shield and shove it, and you, aside.

lines.zh: 我的拳落在门框上，门框塌了。
lines.en: My fist lands on the doorframe, and the doorframe falls.

lines.zh: 土堆鼓起，我先伸出一只手。
lines.en: The soil bulges; I push one hand out first.

lines.zh: 我从坑里爬出来，带着湿泥。
lines.en: I climb from the pit, wet earth clinging to me.

lines.zh: 夜风一吹，我的骨头就接上了。
lines.en: Night wind blows, and my bones knit together.

lines.zh: 这具身体很大，钻出地面花了些力气。
lines.en: This body is big; climbing out took some effort.

lines.zh: 我来了，脚下的草被压平。
lines.en: I arrive, and the grass flattens under me.

lines.zh: 有人把我埋下，我又站起来了。
lines.en: Someone buried me; I am standing again.

lines.zh: 黑暗里我先听见自己的心跳。
lines.en: In the dark I first hear my own heartbeat.

lines.zh: 泥土塞满嘴，我吐了两口。
lines.en: My mouth is full of dirt; I spit twice.

lines.zh: 我不记得怎么死的，只记得饿。
lines.en: I do not recall dying, only being hungry.

lines.zh: 天亮前我钻出来，天亮了也无妨。
lines.en: I rise before dawn; dawn changes nothing.

lines.zh: 坑边有村民的脚印，我先记住。
lines.en: Villager prints by the pit; I memorize them.

lines.zh: 骨头在长，肌肉在裹上来。
lines.en: Bones lengthen, and muscle wraps around them.

lines.zh: 我从坟土里起身，头还低着。
lines.en: I rise from the grave soil, head still low.

lines.zh: 第一步踩空，第二步就稳了。
lines.en: My first step misses; the second holds.

lines.zh: 火在烧我的皮，很吵。
lines.en: Fire chews my hide, and it is loud.

lines.zh: 落下来时，我的腿先着地。
lines.en: Falling, my legs take the ground first.

lines.zh: 水灌进肺里，我不太会游。
lines.en: Water fills my lungs; I swim poorly.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，我还能爬起来。
lines.en: The blast flips me over; I still get up.

lines.zh: 箭插在肩上，像多出一根刺。
lines.en: An arrow in my shoulder, one more thorn.

lines.zh: 药水的光让我想吐。
lines.en: The potion's glow makes me want to vomit.

lines.zh: 饿得发抖，骨头在响。
lines.en: Hunger shakes me; my bones rattle.

lines.zh: 雷电劈下，我闻到自己焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; I smell my own char.

lines.zh: 我掉下去了，下面没有土。
lines.en: I fall, and there is no earth below.
